062/**
063 * An immutable {@link AbstractList} of {@link TypeMirror}s that contains only {@linkplain
064 * BeanTypes#legalBeanType(TypeMirror) legal bean types}, sorted in a specific manner.
065 *
066 * @author <a href="https://about.me/lairdnelson" target="_top">Laird Nelson</a>
067 *
068 * @see #of(Domain, Collection)
069 */
070public final class BeanTypeList extends AbstractList<TypeMirror> implements Constable {
071
072  private final Domain domain; // for Constable only
073
074  private final List<TypeMirror> types;
075
076  private final int interfaceIndex;
077
078  private final boolean proxiable;
079
080  private BeanTypeList(final Domain domain, final Collection<? extends TypeMirror> types) {
081    super();
082    Objects.requireNonNull(types, "types");
083    if (types instanceof BeanTypeList btl) {
084      this.domain = btl.domain;
085      this.types = btl.types;
086      this.interfaceIndex = btl.interfaceIndex;
087      this.proxiable = btl.proxiable;
088    } else {
089      this.domain = domain;
090      int size = types.size();
091      if (size == 0) {
092        this.types = List.of();
093        this.interfaceIndex = -1;
094        this.proxiable = false;
095      } else {
096        final ArrayList<TypeMirror> newTypes;
097        if (types instanceof SupertypeList stl) {
098          // SupertypeList instances are already sorted, which is why we check here. Now we can (potentially) avoid
099          // copying, too, since we can use List#copyOf() in the sunny-day case.
100          int i = 0;
101          for (; i < size; i++) {
102            if (!legalBeanType(stl.get(i))) {
103              break;
104            }
105          }
106          if (i == size) {
107            // All types were legal, everything is sorted
108            newTypes = null;
109            this.types = List.copyOf(types);
110            this.interfaceIndex = stl.interfaceIndex();
111            this.proxiable = proxiable(this.types.get(0), size);
112          } else {
113            newTypes = new ArrayList<>(size);
114            for (int j = 0; j < i; j++) {
115              newTypes.add(stl.get(j)); // the type is known to be legal
116            }
117            ++i; // skip past the illegal type that was encountered
118            for (; i < size; i++) {
119              final TypeMirror t = stl.get(i);
120              if (legalBeanType(t)) {
121                newTypes.add(t);
122              }
123            }
124            newTypes.trimToSize();
125            size = newTypes.size();
126            if (newTypes.isEmpty()) {
127              this.types = List.of();
128              this.interfaceIndex = -1;
129              this.proxiable = false;
130            } else {
131              this.types = unmodifiableList(newTypes);
132              this.interfaceIndex = stl.interfaceIndex() >= size ? -1 : stl.interfaceIndex();
133              this.proxiable = proxiable(newTypes.get(0), size);
134            }
135          }
136        } else {
137          newTypes = new ArrayList<>(size);
138          for (final TypeMirror t : types) {
139            if (legalBeanType(t)) {
140              newTypes.add(t);
141            }
142          }
143          if (newTypes.isEmpty()) {
144            this.types = List.of();
145            this.interfaceIndex = -1;
146            this.proxiable = false;
147          } else {            
148            newTypes.trimToSize();
149            size = newTypes.size();
150            if (size > 1) {
151              Collections.sort(newTypes,
152                               Comparator.comparing(TypeMirror::getKind,
153                                                    PrimitiveAndReferenceTypeKindComparator.INSTANCE)
154                               .thenComparing(new SpecializationComparator(domain))
155                               .thenComparing(this::elementKind,
156                                              ClassesThenInterfacesElementKindComparator.INSTANCE)
157                               .thenComparing(Types::erasedName));
158            }
159            this.types = unmodifiableList(newTypes);
160            int interfaceIndex = -1;
161            for (int i = 0; i < size; i++) {
162              final ElementKind k = this.elementKind(newTypes.get(i));
163              if (k != null && k.isInterface()) {
164                interfaceIndex = i;
165                break;
166              }
167            }
168            this.interfaceIndex = interfaceIndex;
169            this.proxiable = proxiable(newTypes.get(0), size);
170          }
171        }
172      }
173    }
174  }
175
176  private ElementKind elementKind(final TypeMirror t) {
177    final Element e = this.domain.element(t);
178    return e == null ? null : e.getKind();
179  }
180
181  @Override // AbstractList<TypeMirror>
182  public final TypeMirror get(final int index) {
183    return this.types.get(index);
184  }
185
186  /**
187   * Returns the index of the first interface type this {@link BeanTypeList} contains, or a negative value if it
188   * contains no interface types.
189   *
190   * @return the index of the first interface type this {@link BeanTypeList} contains, or a negative value if it
191   * contains no interface types
192   */
193  public final int interfaceIndex() {
194    return this.interfaceIndex;
195  }
196
197  @Override // AbstractList<TypeMirror>
198  public final boolean isEmpty() {
199    return this.types.isEmpty();
200  }
201
202  @Override // Constable
203  public final Optional<? extends ConstantDesc> describeConstable() {
204    return (this.domain instanceof Constable c ? c.describeConstable() : Optional.<ConstantDesc>empty())
205      .flatMap(domainDesc -> Constables.describeConstable(this.types)
206               .map(typesDesc -> DynamicConstantDesc.of(BSM_INVOKE,
207                                                        MethodHandleDesc.ofMethod(STATIC,
208                                                                                  ClassDesc.of(this.getClass().getName()),
209                                                                                  "of",
210                                                                                  MethodTypeDesc.of(ClassDesc.of(BeanTypeList.class.getName()),
211                                                                                                    ClassDesc.of(Domain.class.getName()),
212                                                                                                    CD_Collection)),
213                                                        domainDesc,
214                                                        typesDesc)));
215  }
216
217  /**
218   * Returns {@code true} if and only if this {@link BeanTypeList} is <dfn>proxiable</dfn>.
219   *
220   * @return {@code true} if and only if this {@link BeanTypeList} is <dfn>proxiable</dfn>
221   *
222   * @see BeanTypes#proxiableElement(Element)
223   *
224   * @spec https://jakarta.ee/specifications/cdi/4.0/jakarta-cdi-spec-4.0#unproxyable CDI Specification, version 4.0,
225   * section 2.2.10
226   */
227  public final boolean proxiable() {
228    return this.proxiable;
229  }
230
231  @Override // AbstractList<TypeMirror>
232  public final int size() {
233    return this.types.size();
234  }
235
236
237  /*
238   * Static methods.
239   */
240
241
242  /**
243   * Returns a non-{@code null} {@link BeanTypeList} suitable for the supplied arguments.
244   *
245   * @param domain a {@link Domain} that may be used to determine {@linkplain Domain#subtype(TypeMirror, TypeMirror)
246   * subtype relationships}; may be {@code null} if {@code types} is itself a {@link BeanTypeList}
247   *
248   * @param types a non-{@code null} {@link Collection} of {@link TypeMirror}s; must not be {@code null}
249   *
250   * @return a non-{@code null} {@link BeanTypeList}
251   *
252   * @exception NullPointerException if {@code types} is {@code null}, or if {@code types} is not a {@link BeanTypeList}
253   * and {@code domain} is {@code null}
254   */
255  // Called by describeConstable()
256  public static final BeanTypeList of(final Domain domain, final Collection<? extends TypeMirror> types) {
257    return types instanceof BeanTypeList btl ? btl : new BeanTypeList(domain, types);
258  }
259
260  private static final boolean proxiable(final TypeMirror firstLegalBeanType, final int size) {
261    return
262      // Non-declared otherwise legal bean types cannot be proxied.
263      firstLegalBeanType.getKind() == TypeKind.DECLARED &&
264      ((DeclaredType)firstLegalBeanType).asElement() instanceof TypeElement e &&
265      // This BeanTypeList is still potentially proxiable if the reason the first legal bean type's element failed the
266      // BeanTypes#proxiableElement(Element) test was because the first non-interface bean type was java.lang.Object but we
267      // know that there are interfaces in this list.
268      (proxiableElement(e) || e.getQualifiedName().contentEquals("java.lang.Object") && size > 1);
269  }
270
271}
